operator_text.quote: Oversight and governance of the SNOLAB facility and the operational management is through the SNOLAB Institute Board of Directors, whose member institutions are Carleton University, Laurentian University, Queen’s University, University of Alberta and the Université de Montréal.
operator_text.value: SNOLAB Institute (governed by a Board of Directors whose member institutions are Carleton University, Laurentian University, Queen's University, University of Alberta and the Université de Montréal)

summary.plain: A deep underground physics laboratory two kilometres below the surface in an active nickel mine near Sudbury, Canada. The thick rock overhead blocks nearly all cosmic rays, letting scientists search for dark matter and study neutrinos in an extremely quiet environment.
summary.technical: Class-2000 clean-room underground laboratory at the 6800 ft level (~2070 m rock overburden) of Vale's Creighton nickel mine near Sudbury, Ontario, reached via 9 Shaft; an expansion of the original SNO cavern, governed by a consortium of five Canadian universities.
